meta.name: architecture-optimization
meta.description: Guided journey from a working codebase grown slow and tangled to one measurably fast, cleanly bounded, and readable. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - working-with-legacy-code, clean-architecture, software-design-philosophy, refactoring-patterns, system-design, ddia-systems, release-it, pragmatic-programmer - every phase carries its method inline so it runs standalone, asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (PERFORMANCE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, ARCHITECTURE-OPTIMIZATION-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to make an app faster, untangle drifted boundaries, fix slow endpoints and queries, or says 'it works but it is slow and getting worse'. For an untested prototype, improve-code-quality; for an aged codebase you fear to touch, remove-technical-debt; for greenfield structure, design-code-architecture; for marketing-site page speed, improve-website. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.

copy.tagline: 把越来越慢、越来越乱的代码逐步优化成清晰高效的结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的应用能跑但越来越慢,代码越来越难以维护
copy.tagline_en: Refactor a slow, tangled codebase into a fast, clean, readable one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your app works but is getting slower and harder to maintain.

howto.what: 把优化拆成八个阶段,依次处理旧代码、架构边界、设计、重构、系统设计、数据层、发布可靠性和工程习惯。每个决策点都先问用户,再把结果记到项目 docs/ 文件夹,并先建立性能基线和行为测试,再动手改代码。
howto.when: 当用户想让应用变快、理清漂移的架构边界、修复慢接口或慢查询,或说“能用但越来越慢”时触发。

say.text: 我的应用现在很慢,帮我做架构优化。
say.note: 开始八阶段旅程,先做现状盘点。

say.text: 继续之前的优化进度,先读 docs 里的计划文件。
say.note: 恢复上次未完成的阶段。

say.text: 先别改代码,帮我测一下当前性能并建立基线。
say.note: 进入第一阶段:固定行为和性能。

howto.what_en: Splits optimization into eight phases (legacy code, architecture, design, refactoring, system design, data layer, release, habits). Asks the user at each decision, records results in docs/, and measures performance and pins behavior before editing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to make an app faster, untangle drifted boundaries, fix slow endpoints or queries, or says 'it works but it is slow and getting worse'.

say_en.text: My app is slow now—help me optimize the architecture.
say_en.note: Starts the eight-phase journey with an intake check.

say_en.text: Continue the previous optimization; read the plan in docs first.
Don't touch code yet—measure current performance and set a baseline.
